entities.name: Arthur
entities.description: Legendary mousefolk Marigold Knight of Bloomburrow who rides a wicker steed and wields a lance.

entities.name: Zinnia
entities.description: Singer of songs of Arthur's deeds.

entities.name: Mabel
entities.description: Savior of Valley, said to have been given a sword lesson by Arthur.

entities.name: Valley
entities.description: Mousefolk home whose people believe in Arthur's heroic acts.

entities.name: Calamity Graveyard
entities.description: Place Arthur is said to have crossed with a Sunspine Lynx at his tail.

events.summary: Arthur is said to have crossed the Calamity Graveyard with a Sunspine Lynx at his tail and escaped.
events.quote: Who could forget the crossing of the Calamity Graveyard with a Sunspine Lynx at his tail and how he escaped with nary a singed whisker?

events.summary: Arthur is said to have given Mabel a sword lesson.
events.quote: Or when he gave Mabel herself, the savior of Valley , a sword lesson?

relations.quote: Many songs have been written of Arthur's deeds, some sung by Zinnia themself.
